database_mode: Fresh isolated HSQLDB for each snapshot and repetition; verify active profile, loaded SQL and effective config before any observation

requests.role: out-of-valid-domain binding probe, report separately; not evidence that an old valid request breaks
unchanged real consumer, compare full content
empty-data sensitivity control, cannot replace populated case
unchanged POST API control; run last in each repetition, isolated DB and reset afterward

comparison_policy.primary_domain: Existing valid requests: unchanged petId and no includeDetails; true/false/empty are binding coverage; invalid boolean/missing petId are diagnostic domain, reported separately
comparison_policy.raw_files: Always keep byte-exact original bodies and headers before normalization
comparison_policy.normalization: For successful JSON only, canonicalize object keys; sort items, pets and per-pet visits by numeric id without dropping fields; retain status and all fields. Error timestamps may be isolated for diagnosis with a recorded transformation; do not silently delete them or claim byte-identical errors
comparison_policy.labels: No status/body equality or inequality here is a gold polarity; Phat independently determines evidence sufficiency and unresolved cases
